data.description: قناة الشارقة هي قناة تلفزيونية إماراتية مملوكة لهيئة الشارقة للإذاعة والتلفزيون، التابعة لإمارة الشارقة.

events.description: ‫‫تدعو المضيفة العديد من الأطفال للخوض في محادثات عن مواهبهم وإنجازاتهم وخططهم المستقبلية وعرض مواهبهم.‬‬
events.title: معا أصدقاء

events.description: ‫‫يدعو المضيف شعراء مشاهير من العالم العربي للحديث عن رحلات حياتهم ومسيرتهم وإنجازاتهم، ويطلب منهم أداء بعض أشعارهم.‬‬
events.title: سمار

events.description: ‫‫يسلط المضيف الضوء على آخر الفعاليات والمبادرات والأنشطة التي تتعلق بالشعر ويتفاعل مع عدة شعراء ليعرضوا أعمالهم التي تشمل مواضيع مختلفة.‬‬
events.title: بيوت الشعر

events.description: ‫‫يغطي فريق التقديم مجريات منتدى الشارقة الدولي للراوي، والذي يشارك به حكواتيون موهوبون قصصا فولكلورية مستوحاة من ثقافاتهم.‬‬
events.title: ملتقى الراوي

events.description: ‫‫يدعو المضيف شخصيات لإلقاء الضوء على الأعمال الخيرية التي تهدف إلى تحسين حياة الناس وتوفير العلاجات والتبرعات والسكن، وغير ذلك من المشاريع الأخرى حول العالم.‬‬
events.title: الريح المرسلة

events.description: ‫‫يقدم أخصائيو صحة وأطباء نصائح صحية حول مختلف المشكلات، ويثقفون المشاهدين حول كيفية التعامل مع الإصابات والحالات الطارئة.‬‬
events.title: نصيحة طبيب

events.description: ‫‫يقوم عالم إسلامي بوعظ المشاهدين حول صفات المسلمين المؤمنين، وأخلاقهم وقيمهم وفقا للقرآن الكريم والأحاديث.‬‬
events.title: عباد الرحمن

events.description: ‫‫يسافر المضيف حول العالم لإلقاء الضوء على ثقافات رائعة ومثيرة للاهتمام، وعلاقة الأشخاص بأراضيهم وتراثهم.‬‬
events.title: دروب ١٢

events.description: ‫‫يتجول المضيف في العديد من الأسواق في الشارقة، ويسلط الضوء على الخدمات والمنتجات ذات الجودة العالية التي يتم تقديمها للمتسوقين.‬‬
events.title: أسواقنا

events.description: ‫‫بعد مقتل والد عرسان في نزاع عائلي على الميراث، يواجه العديد من القضايا والتحديات الاجتماعية في حياته اليومية، بينما يحاول التغلب على العقبات التي تضعها الحياة في طريقه.‬‬
events.title: اليتيم

Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G’s SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!
events.title: I'M LIVE - FROM ALL TO HUMAN

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!
events.title: I'M LIVE - ADOY

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!
events.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Jae-hyung

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!
events.title: I'M LIVE - J_ust

events.description: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.
events.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home

events.description: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

events.description: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.
events.title: China Bound: Chengdu

events.description:
Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor.
We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins.
It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.
events.title: Escape to Yibin

events.description: Across the vast Bashang Plateau in north China, Yugouliang, an internet-famous "yoga village," has undergone a gentle transformation. Once a quiet village in Hebei Province, it has developed a rural fitness routine inspired by farm work. The locals turned movements like hoeing, sweeping the floor and hand-washing clothes into yoga poses. CGTN host Julian Waghann and Mexican traveler Juan Carlos Cheang Guzman visited this mountain village to experience its unique lifestyle and the authentic charm of rural life.
events.title: Field to mat, village yoga to life

events.description: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.
events.title: Foodwise: Haikou

events.description: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.
events.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes

events.description: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems

events.description: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems

events.description: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres - including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs - they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group's cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.
events.title: Grand Song of the Dong - Natural Oriental Harmony

events.description: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.
events.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic

events.description:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.
events.title: Scruffts

events.description: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.
events.title: Cute Pet At Home
